name: IBM 650
story: The IBM 650 was installed at Treasury in 1960 and formally opened in March 1961. Its first major public-service task was the fortnightly payroll for about 34,000 staff.
The installed data-processing system used magnetic tape and punched-card output. The computer room needed air conditioning, a raised floor for cables and standby power.
